import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Source file path
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_38/test_0.csv"
    # Target output path
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_38/target_multisource_cot.csv"

    # Load source data
    df_source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path)

    # Inspect columns of source0:
    # ['user_id', 'time', 'sore.throat.cough', 'runnynose.congestion.sneezing', 'fever',
    #  'nausea.vomiting.diarrhea', 'sad.depressed', 'open.stressed']

    # Target schema: ['user_id': int, 'sad': float, 'stressed': float]
    # Mapping:
    # sad = aggregate of 'sad.depressed'
    # stressed = aggregate of 'open.stressed'
    # Group by user_id

    # Aggregate by user_id:
    # Use mean aggregation for sad.depressed and open.stressed to get float values per user_id

    # Convert columns to numeric (in case of any non-numeric or missing values)
    df_source0['sad.depressed'] = pd.to_numeric(df_source0['sad.depressed'], errors='coerce')
    df_source0['open.stressed'] = pd.to_numeric(df_source0['open.stressed'], errors='coerce')

    # Group by user_id and aggregate mean for sad.depressed and open.stressed
    df_agg = df_source0.groupby('user_id', as_index=False).agg({
        'sad.depressed': 'mean',
        'open.stressed': 'mean'
    })

    # Rename columns to target schema
    df_agg.rename(columns={
        'sad.depressed': 'sad',
        'open.stressed': 'stressed'
    }, inplace=True)

    # Ensure user_id is integer type
    df_agg['user_id'] = df_agg['user_id'].astype(int)

    # Save to target CSV
    df_agg.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
